integrity: The Laurent-polynomial proof is independent of the finite verification. Classical modulo-three results and general automaton methods are attributed. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only the valuations zero and one for the ordinary central trinomial sequence at the prime three; terms divisible by nine are not assigned exact higher valuations. Explicit priority remains subject to further literature scrutiny.
title: Ternary-neighbor criterion for central trinomial coefficients modulo nine
